summary.result: The results can be used with the Cone Penetrometer Test (CPT) result to analyse ground condition.
summary.background: Measurement of electrical resistivity in soils has been used for many years with purpose of estimating in situ porosity or density.
summary.method: In the case of using groundwater, the resistivity was in the range of over 1000 ${\omega}{\cdot}m$ , but in the case of using polluted water by leachate, the resistivity decreased significantly down to 10~ 100 ${\omega}{\cdot}m$ for the same moisture content.
